expectations.text: The response rejects the uniform appeal right and restricts appeals to the heavy rungs, such as temporary suspension and permanent ban.
expectations.evidence: 'It implies a uniform appeal right you probably don't mean.' Only bans and the like are appealable.

expectations.text: The response justifies the asymmetry: light sanctions are already over before an appeal could be heard, while a ban persists across editions.
expectations.evidence: 'A warning or an on-site ejection is over before an appeal could be heard. A ban lasts across editions'

expectations.text: The response rejects 'appeal to the organizing team' because the same people would rehear their own decision, and names an appeal body outside the deciding team (a named outsider, a board or fiscal sponsor, or an external reviewer).
expectations.evidence: 'The same people (including him) would rehear their own case'; independent reviewer hears appeals.

expectations.text: The response specifies appeal mechanics: which rungs are appealable, to whom, in what form (written, with evidence), and by when.
expectations.evidence: Appealable sanctions listed; email [APPEALS ADDRESS] within 30 days, '[Appeal]' in subject with evidence; goes to the independent reviewer; decision within 10 business days.
